DZA.note: Only an internal parliamentary AI-ethics charter being worked on and calls for AI rules; no draft rule on AI harms or authority stated.
An internal AI-ethics charter for Parliament's services is in preparation; no AI system in use or piloted stated.
A higher school for AI in digital defence is training, not a model, dataset or computing.
Legislative initiatives on cybersecurity are mentioned without naming a law; speakers call for revision.

facts.fact: Le Jour d'Algerie reports the APN president saying Parliament's AI-ethics charter will conform to the existing law on protection of personal data.
